title: SEC1: xcid_client fetch_entry has no timeout on peer connect or protocol exchange
description: In xcid_client.rs, try_fetch_from_peer calls TcpStream::connect with no timeout (line 112), and run_xcid_protocol reads the server greeting and XCID response with no timeout (lines 145-164). If a peer accepts the TCP connection but then stalls (hung process, network blackhole), the fetch blocks indefinitely. The fetch_entry loop tries peers in order, so a single hung peer blocks all subsequent peers from being tried. In a multi-peer config, one unhealthy peer can make all XCID fetches fail for as long as the hung connection persists. Fix: wrap TcpStream::connect and each read_line in tokio::time::timeout with a configurable deadline (default ~10s).
